name: Corporate Action Narrative 1 Code
definition: Specifies the narrative type of a corporate action.

TAXE.name: Taxation Conditions
TAXE.definition: Provides taxation conditions that cannot be included within the structured fields of this message.

REGI.name: Registration Details
REGI.definition: Provides information required for the registration.

WTRC.name: Withholding Tax Relief Certification
WTRC.definition: Certification process for withholding tax reduction or exemption based on the tax status of the holder.

RFMC.name: ICSD Refusal Of Mark Up Down Confirmation
RFMC.definition: In the context of a corporate action, an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) refuses a mark-up/mark-down confirmation sent by the account servicer.

PAUT.name: Chasing Of Prior Authorization
PAUT.definition: International Central Securities Depository (ICSD) chases the authorisation from the account servicer in order to process the exchange from global temporary to global permanent.

CTIN.name: Confirmation Of Holding Transfer
CTIN.definition: Confirmation of transfer of interests between International Central Securities Depositories (ICSDs) following a corporate actions.
